question: "...it is important to ensure the purity of silver and wear it in moderation," what is the function of the article "the" before''purity''?

options.text: It refers to a specific known purity
It is used by mistake and should be removed
It is used to generalize the idea of purity

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• This question tests the use of **Definite Articles**.
 
• The article **"the"** is used before the noun "purity" because it is followed by a qualifying phrase (**"of silver"**). In English grammar, when we use the structure "the + abstract noun + of + s
